category: Agent document runtime — flow documents only (not OCR suites, not office GUIs)
north_star: A stranger opening github.com/kevin9327/docagent must immediately see picture in, PDF/A out — hero art, a capability matrix, and real convert shots with the teal harbor mark under the H2, at the visual density of MinerU/Docling/Pandoc. First screen: PNG/JPEG in Markdown/HTML/DOCX/ODT become a PDF/A XObject. Capsule hashed. GPU-free. Not OCR. DocAgent wins the agent-runtime axes: Command/Query/Event, capsule hashes, integer layout, byte-identical reruns, GPU-free convert. Hangul is a regional codec, not the first-screen story. Demo-image gap is closed. Next gap: PDF page density vs WeasyPrint/MinerU.
